title: question_shares collection document
description: One explicit share grant for a question. A question with visibility=shared is usable only by its owner and the grantees listed here; permission=view allows reading, permission=use also allows inserting the question into one's own survey. Semantic invariants (checked by the service): granted_by must be the question owner; the owner does not need a share record; (entity_id, grantee_id) is unique.

permission.description: view is read-only; use also allows inserting the question into one's own surveys.

granted_by.description: User who granted the share; must be the question owner.
